title: Guest shadowbanned after posting photo with Malone at Heretic-con

tellings.quote: Honestly, same when I posted that picture uh with him back in Heredicon, dude, I got shadowbanned instantly.

plain: An unnamed researcher on Jesse Michels's podcast says that after posting a photo of himself with a man named Robert Malone, taken at a gathering called Heretic-con, he was instantly shadowbanned on X, the site once called Twitter, meaning his posts were quietly hidden from others. He tells it as a sign, if true, that being linked to certain people gets you silenced online.
